name: aj-house-rules
description: aj's Claude Code tools. Two plugins: house-rules, which enforces the global CLAUDE.md rules as hooks; and house-style, which pins the fonts, colour and prose voice every visual artefact is built on.

plugins.name: house-rules
plugins.description: Enforces aj's global CLAUDE.md rules as hooks: no hidden background work, no unasked git mutations, no unchecked destructive commands.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Pins one house theme - fonts, colour, shape and prose voice - and injects it into every session, so visual work is built on a look you chose rather than one the model invented.
